name: Om Namah Shivaya
description: A salutation to Shiva, the inner Self. Chanted for surrender, transformation, and inner stillness.

name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
description: The 'great death-conquering' mantra, chanted for healing, protection, and longevity.

name: Hare Krishna Maha Mantra
description: The maha-mantra of bhakti yoga, chanted for devotion and joyful surrender.

name: Om Mani Padme Hum
description: The jewel in the lotus — a mantra of compassion central to Tibetan Buddhist practice.

name: Gayatri Mantra
description: The ultimate prayer for enlightenment and universal light. It stimulates the intellect and purifies the subconscious mind, leading the practitioner toward higher consciousness.

name: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
description: A salutation to Vasudeva (Krishna/Vishnu), chanted for grace and devotion.

name: Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha
description: An invocation to Ganesha, remover of obstacles, chanted before new beginnings.

name: Sri Rama Jaya Rama
deva: श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम
chant: Shri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram
description: A devotional chant to Rama, embodiment of dharma and steadfastness.

name: Om Namo Narayanaya
description: A salutation to Narayana (Vishnu), chanted for protection and equanimity.

name: Om Shanti Shanti Shanti
description: A threefold invocation of peace — of body, speech, and mind.

name: Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah
description: An invocation to Saraswati, goddess of knowledge, art, and clarity of speech.

name: Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
description: May all beings everywhere be happy and free — a closing dedication chant.
